mapper.select: SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, om.status AS status, om.payment_status AS paymentStatus, om.created_at AS createdAt, om.start_at AS startAt, om.end_at AS endAt FROM order_main om WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY om.created_at DESC, om.order_id DESC
